
# Immanuel Church of God – Southampton

> A Christ-centred Pentecostal church in Southampton, UK, welcoming Malayalam-speaking and English-speaking families and visitors.

Official website: https://icfsouthampton.org/

## Church Information

- Current name: Immanuel Church of God
- Former name: Immanuel Christian Fellowship
- Location: Southampton, Hampshire, United Kingdom
- Sunday worship: 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM
- Meeting venue: Regents Park Community College, King Edward Avenue, Southampton SO16 4GW
- Website: https://icfsouthampton.org/
- Email: icfsouthampton@gmail.com
- Phone: +44 7908 676 335

## About the Church

Immanuel Church of God is a Pentecostal Christian congregation serving Southampton and surrounding communities. The church welcomes people from all backgrounds and offers worship, prayer, Bible teaching, fellowship and ministry for children and young people.
